title: Fruit adventure
continuity: One tiny taupe-gray rat chef with round pink-centered ears, dark oval eyes, pink nose, fine whiskers, rosy cheeks, cream pocket apron and oversized mint puffy hat. Rat is the only character. All fruit is ordinary faceless food. Same peach kitchen, left arched window, mint cabinets, right wooden herb shelf, cream counter, mint scalloped bowl and mint gingham towel.

title: Funny day
continuity: Same cute round yellow rubber duck, orange beak, glossy dark oval eyes, rosy cheeks, small crest and stubby wings. Same mint fabric school backpack with yellow zipper, round daisy patch on front pocket, little yellow duck charm on zipper, purple bottle in side pocket and purple spiral notebook. Warm peach-and-lilac classroom, wooden desktop, tall window left with little schoolhouse outside, rainbow drawing on wall, colorful books on right. Introduce only on final page a kind adult woman teacher with warm medium-brown skin, dark curly bob, round plum glasses and lavender cardigan; consistent rubber duck and backpack must remain.

title: Little kindness
continuity: Cream bunny, mint scarf, lavender mouse, yellow umbrella. Same rainy cobblestone garden throughout.

pages.text: Rain tapped on a tiny yellow umbrella.
pages.alt: Cream bunny in a mint scarf watches raindrops tap on her yellow umbrella.

pages.text: Bunny spotted a mouse with very soggy whiskers.
pages.alt: Bunny notices a tiny lavender mouse standing in the rain with wet whiskers.

pages.text: She lifted her umbrella and made room for her new friend.
pages.beat: There’s always room for a friend
pages.alt: Bunny lifts her yellow umbrella to welcome the lavender mouse beneath it.

pages.text: They splashed through the puddles together.
pages.alt: Bunny and mouse splash happily through a garden puddle beneath one umbrella.

pages.text: A little kindness made the rainy day feel warm.
pages.beat: A little kindness goes a long way
pages.alt: Bunny and mouse stand together on the wet garden path under the yellow umbrella as the rain eases.

title: Helping paws
continuity: Exact same honey-brown plush bear, cream muzzle, round ears, glossy brown eyes, rosy cheeks, dark nose; mint apron with cream front pocket embroidered green sprout and back bow, no other clothes. Same much smaller round hedgehog with cream face and belly, layered soft brown spines, small pink ears, rosy cheeks, dark nose and brown paws, no clothes. Same wooden slat basket with curved handle, red apples with stems/leaves. Same flat warm cobblestone orchard path, apple tree and rustic fence left, cream stone cottage with wooden arched window right, roses/daisies, distant lavender hills. Bear roughly twice hedgehog height. No raised platforms, no sudden scenery changes. A cream-and-mint checkered picnic blanket beside path is introduced in page1 and stays in same garden.
